title: Daily digest: Hyderabad’s biggest literary celebration | Andhra poll panel to decide today on ext | Maharashtra State Transport staff issue  | Naidu Extends Birthday Greetings to Amit
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: Hyderabad’s biggest literary celebration to return this December.
Andhra poll panel to decide today on extending ULB nomination deadline.
Maharashtra State Transport staff issue notice for protest ahead of Diwali.
Naidu Extends Birthday Greetings to Amit Shah.
